messages:
Ana: Quick catch while prepping the localization pass  Jakarta (id) is missing from the SEA region table. We should add ap-southeast-5 and a one-line data residency note for Indonesia. Draft: https://redwood-internal.docs/sea-jkt-draft. Can someone add a Go header example and a tiny migration mapping?

Ravi: I'll add the table row + migration mapping. Suggested residency language: 'Processed in-region where capacity is available; contact support for private deployments.' Keeps legal happy.

Tess: Go header snippet for ops:
```go
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Region", "ap-southeast-5")
```
I'll also add a curl example for the migration guide.

Connor: Added a short note under model catalog: 'Model availability may vary by region.' Also added the mapping table for legacy codes (ap-southeast -> ap-southeast-1) and a line in the SDK migration: 'Region header supersedes legacy parameter.' Opening PR now.

check-bot: Link-checker: 1 broken internal link found in draft -> /docs/regions#ap-southeast anchor missing. Commented on PR.

Ana: Thanks, fixed the anchor and updated the draft. PR ready for one review: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5342.

Ravi: Reviewed and approved. Minor nit: prefer 'in-region where available' instead of 'in-region where capacity is available' for conciseness. Pushed small edit.

Tess: Re-ran link-checks and linter, all green :white_check_mark:. Merge after merge queue clears.
